nextSystemAdjustment.searchDryFix: The next UI/code change should make the search action obvious around the whole content moment: video topic, GLB model, podcast/source moment, market/context data, and source/backlink proof.
nextSystemAdjustment.proofDryFix: If proof route opens remain zero, add stronger internal route bridges from homepage/category/system panels to the matching watch and blog proof routes.
nextSystemAdjustment.sourceDryFix: If source opens remain zero, attach visible source/backlink labels to the complete content object before creating more public pages.
nextSystemAdjustment.overseerFix: Every pool shuffle must report whether the whole system should hold, promote, rewrite, or reset before the next deployment.
nextSystemAdjustment.deployRule: Deploy only when a public proof artifact, llms metadata, route metadata, or behavior capture path changes.

successThreshold.rankGuardrail: No rank improvement claim until Search Console returns real query rows, impressions, clicks, or average position.
